paper_title: On Colourability of Polygon Visibility Graphs
statement: In this paper we have showed that the problem of deciding 6-colourability for visibility graphs of simple polygons, is NP-hard. We have also showed that the 4-colouring problem can be solved for visibility graphs of simple polygons, in polynomial time. However, the 5-colouring problem still remains open. Also, we would like to point out to the reader that the 4-colouring and 5-colouring problems on polygons with holes require further study.
